investigations.question: Do the twin satellites read as shown, and the formation row as supports, when the drone beat is actually judged with motion evidence? The missing (0.28) / unsupported (0.33) verdicts were reached by panels that never saw the 04-hazard-drone beat (old 4-of-6 selection), while level source (twin starlinkSprite drones x=2350/2500, y=240/222, staggered 2400/2900ms patrols) and the retained staged drone still (both craft visible, one partly behind the title overlay, small at 0.05 scale) both show two craft present. A frozen staged still cannot prove formation flight either way.
